title: Security Council Unanimously Renews UN Verification Mission in Colombia to Oct 2027
detail: On Oct 30 the Security Council unanimously renewed the UN Verification Mission in Colombia until 31 Oct 2027, as the country marks ten years since the Final Peace Agreement. The same day UN Cyprus envoy María Ángela Holguín met Greek Cypriot leader Nikos Christodoulides, with a meeting with Tufan Erhürman planned early the following week.
